sentences.text: What if you got dropped into ancient Rome... with just your phone?
Caesar banned carts by day, and this guy did not care.
Then a nice stranger offers you mouthwash.
Roman writers say people swished it to whiten their teeth.
So you snap a selfie to remember this.
[lowering their voice] And in Rome, magicians got burned alive.
[shouting] Sorcerer! Take him to the emperor!
